## 席位核对 · Amendment · 2026-11-05T21:46Z · claim 6670283250 file surface

File surface: + `packages/rest/src/meta-item-read-gate.ts`, the layered chain only (`createMetaLayeredAnswer`, its gated and masked layer lists). Measured by the card thread: both doors serve `/layers` through that one chain, which gates and masks only `effective` / `code` / `overlay` and lets any other key through, so an ungated `draft` would bypass the existing pending-draft admission. The `draft` layer is served only to callers the existing `mayReadPendingDrafts` predicate admits; a caller not admitted gets no `draft` key. This applies an existing admission rule to a new member; it relaxes nothing.

Serial constraints: PR #30459 touches the same file in the translation helpers, not the layered chain; no textual overlap measured. Whichever lands second merges `main` in. Everything else in claim 6670283250 stands.
